name: Custom CRM
summary: A CRM built around how you work: contacts, organizations, opportunities and dated actions, with an import from your spreadsheet or old tool and a weekly review.
description: Start from the four lists every CRM needs and change them to fit: stages, fields and views are yours. Meant for people leaving a spreadsheet, Notion, Airtable or Trello who want their data in a CRM without a project. It keeps a note of where each record was imported from.

prompt.intro: Set up a custom CRM in my Customermates workspace: contacts, organizations, opportunities with stages and dated actions, an import from my spreadsheet or old tool and a weekly review.
questions: Which tool or spreadsheet do your records come from, and can you export it?
What stages does a deal go through in your business?
Which fields do you really use today, and which can you leave behind?
Who works in the CRM, and who owns which records?
